visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit living room with white walls, a group of approximately ten young adults is crowded around a small silver folding table. A man in a white t-shirt acts as the dealer, while others lean in with excited facial expressions. The background shows a wooden pegboard with various toys and a red "DRAGON" banner hanging on a blue curtain. (2) A high-angle close-up captures the game table's surface where an Ace of Spades is placed between an Ace of Hearts and an Ace of Diamonds. Hands reach in to organize large stacks of coins and several 100 NTD bills. The man in the grey shirt looks on with a mixture of shock and disbelief. (3) The man in the grey t-shirt and glasses is shown jumping energetically in the background near a grey L-shaped sofa, his arms raised in celebration. A toddler wearing a festive red sweater stands nearby on a play mat, watching the chaotic scene. The room is filled with personal belongings and household clutter. (4) The camera focuses tightly on a purple accordion-style wallet being held by the man in the grey shirt. He slowly pulls out multiple red banknotes, his eyes squinted and his mouth slightly open in a stunned, silent reaction. A TV screen in the background displays a news or variety show program. (5) In a sequence of quick cuts, the card table is shown again for the fourth, fifth, and sixth rounds. Each time, the middle card matches one of the outer cards, resulting in a loss. The man in the grey shirt moves from counting money to staring blankly at the table as he places his last few bills down. (6) The final visual phase depicts the man in the grey shirt sitting dejectedly on the grey-patterned floor rug, leaning his back against a light-colored wooden cabinet. He holds the open, empty purple wallet in his hands, staring off into the distance with a hollow, defeated expression.
